pool.text: Ibn Battuta visited the Pharos lighthouse and found it partly in ruins.
After the Battle of Ridaniya, the city was conquered by Ottoman Turks.
French troops stormed Alexandria during Napoleon's military operations expedition to Egypt.
British forces won a considerable victory over the French at Alexandria.
Alexandria regained its former prominence with the construction of the Mahmoudiyah Canal.
An extensive tramway network was built in Alexandria and remains the oldest in Africa.
A monument was built to honor Khedive Ismail with a statue at the top.
The city of Alexandria was a target of an Israeli bombing campaign.
Mansheya Square was the site of a failed assassination attempt on Gamal Abdel Nasser.
Europeans began leaving Alexandria following the Suez Crisis outburst of Arab nationalism.
The monument was transformed into the Monument to the Unknown Soldier without the statue.
Roger Hopkins and Mark Lehrner conducted an obelisk erecting experiment.
The Bibliotheca Alexandrina was inaugurated near the site of the old library.
The Alexandria National Museum was inaugurated on the last day of the year.
The Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology was set up as a research university.
The Greek University of Patras announced opening a branch in Alexandria.
The museum re-opened to the public after extensive renovations and expansion works.
Alexandria joined the UNESCO Global Network of Learning Cities organization.
The Oxford Centre for Maritime Archaeology published findings of a temple to Isis.
Terminal 2 is the brand new terminal and was inaugurated in Alexandria.
